verdict.rationale: The MCP server separates reads from writes and deletes so each category can be approved independently, and each data-in integration gets its own API key limited to sending data. Both offer some least-privilege control for agents. However, nothing documents issuing scoped credentials for an agent, and the CLI is described as giving agents 'full access' to workspaces. Missing for 10: documented creation of scoped or restricted API keys for agents, per-resource or per-action permission scopes on App/Journeys API credentials, guidance on least-privilege setup for MCP/CLI auth, and independent corroboration.
